parsed.explanation: Transgender visitors face moderate social risk, particularly if visibly non-conforming or outed outside progressive urban pockets. Deeply rooted stigma persists across society, with ground-level evidence documenting frequent discrimination in public spaces and institutions, as well as physical and sexual harassment in provincial areas. Recent anti-LGBTQ public protests and an uptick in online hate speech and death threats from political supporters indicate rising hostility. While annual pride parades take place and community drop-in centres operate in the capital, public attitudes remain conservative. Visitors are unlikely to face systematic mob violence or state-directed persecution, but risk verbal harassment, societal hostility, and street-level abuse.
